query:
UPDATE handles SET (id, 
account_id, 
username, 
user_id, 
status, 
created_at, 
force_hydrate, 
total_collabs, 
total_collab_rewards, 
x_refresh_token, 
invalidated_x_refresh_token, 
profile_image_url) = ((CASE $2::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $3 ELSE id END), (CASE $4::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $5 ELSE account_id END), (CASE $6::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $7 ELSE username END), (CASE $8::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $9 ELSE user_id END), (CASE $10::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $11 ELSE status END), (CASE $12::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $13 ELSE created_at END), (CASE $14::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $15 ELSE force_hydrate END), (CASE $16::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $17 ELSE total_collabs END), (CASE $18::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $19 ELSE total_collab_rewards END), (CASE $20::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $21 ELSE x_refresh_token END), (CASE $22::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $23 ELSE invalidated_x_refresh_token END), (CASE $24::boolean WHEN TRUE THEN $25 ELSE profile_image_url END)) WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id as "id!: i32", 
account_id as "account_id!: String", 
username as "username!: String", 
user_id as "user_id!: String", 
status as "status!: HandleStatus", 
created_at as "created_at!: DateTime < Utc >", 
force_hydrate as "force_hydrate!: bool", 
total_collabs as "total_collabs!: i32", 
total_collab_rewards as "total_collab_rewards!: String", 
x_refresh_token as "x_refresh_token!: Option < String >", 
invalidated_x_refresh_token as "invalidated_x_refresh_token!: Option < String >", 
profile_image_url as "profile_image_url!: Option < String >"
